subject: CedarPoint onboarding — priorities, owners, and pre-go-live checkpoints
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Priya Sundar <priya.sundar@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: CedarPoint onboarding — initial handoff and pre-go-live asks

Hi team,

We closed CedarPoint (DEAL-8921) last week — deposit processed and DocuSign signed. Quick handoff so CS can scope the first 90 days and confirm acceptance gating. Priya from CedarPoint is on this thread. Short summary / asks below: 

Deal summary (quick):
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (2x A100 equivalent capacity) + Console observability
- Target go-live: week of Jan 18, 2027 (customer asked for a hard target)
- Billing: monthly reserved capacity (sales committed)

Immediate CS asks:
1) Confirm primary CS owner and SRE contact for networking pre-checks.
2) Review and sign off SOW attachment (CPH_SOW_v1.pdf) and highlight any missing acceptance criteria.
3) Confirm data residency and KMS expectations (customer will use Azure KeyVault).
4) Block a 60-minute kickoff in mid-Dec for sprint 0 planning.

Attachments: CPH_SOW_v1.pdf (draft), Network_Checklist.xlsx (customer network requirements), MVP_Rollout_Plan.md

Monica — would you pick up CS ownership? Karthik to own the technical onboarding and SRE coordination. Tessa can run the kickoff scheduling.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Priya Sundar <priya.sundar@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint onboarding — initial handoff and pre-go-live asks

Thanks, Dylan — happy to take primary CS ownership for CedarPoint. 

Immediate responses: 
- I accept the owner role. I will be the primary point for onboarding, adoption, and acceptance gating.
- Karthik, if you can confirm SRE pairing (names + availability), I will share the Network_Checklist with the customer and ask them to fill the highlighted portions.
- I have one concern: SOW v1 omits an explicit definition of "performance acceptance" (p95 ≤ 300ms for 512 tokens). Can we capture that before SOW final?

Next steps I’ll take this week:
- Update SOW with a short performance acceptance clause and return to Dylan + Priya for sign-off.
- Propose three kickoff slots for the week of Dec 13 (Tessa, please hold 12/14 09:00–10:00 PT as tentative).
- Run a quick risk checklist and share with internal stakeholders by Friday.

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | ext. 408

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Priya Sundar <priya.sundar@cedarpointhealth.com>, Arjun Menon <arjun.menon@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:36:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint onboarding — initial handoff and pre-go-live asks

Thanks team — Karthik here. A couple of technical notes and proposed owners: 

SRE pairing: 
- Primary SRE: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai) — will lead infra validation and capacity tests.
- Secondary SRE: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai) — networking and region failover.

Technical items to clarify before kickoff: 
- Azure KeyVault: customer-managed keys — we need the KMS policy and service principal ahead of staging.
- VPC Peering / PrivateLink: Network_Checklist has required IP ranges; ask customer to confirm NAT/firewall egress rules.
- Baseline perf test: I'll schedule a short load run in our pre-prod to validate p95 and kv-cache behavior — target the week after kickoff.

I attached a draft MVP rollout (MVP_Rollout_Plan.md) with a proposed 6-week sprint breakdown and acceptance gates (staging smoke, perf validation, integration sign-off).

Monica — I agree on adding explicit p95 perf clause to SOW. Happy to review language.

-Karthik

Attachments: MVP_Rollout_Plan.md

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | (650) 555-2103

From: Priya Sundar <priya.sundar@cedarpointhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arjun Menon <arjun.menon@cedarpointhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CedarPoint onboarding — initial handoff and pre-go-live asks

Thanks all — Priya here from CedarPoint. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We confirm Azure KeyVault for KMS and will generate a service principal. Arjun will be the technical lead and will follow up with the service principal details once we validate scope internally (target by Dec 10).
- Network checklist: we can complete the spreadsheet but need a bit more detail on the required outbound IP ranges for telemetry. Can you confirm whether telemetry uses a fixed set of egress IPs?
- Acceptances: the team is comfortable with a perf clause; we'll defer to Redwood's suggested wording for p95 so legal can sign off faster.
- Kickoff: Dec 14 09:00–10:00 PT works for our team.

Attachments: none

Thanks,
Priya

--
Priya Sundar
Director of Platform Engineering | CedarPoint Health
priya.sundar@cedarpointhealth.com

Confirmed: I have booked the Dec 14 kickoff (60 minutes) and sent calendar invites to internal owners + Priya/Arjun.

Action checklist I created (internal):
- [ ] Monica: Finalize SOW performance clause and send revised SOW to Dylan by EOD 2026-12-04.
- [ ] Karthik: Share staging perf test plan + rough timeline by 2026-12-09.
- [ ] Rishi/Vivek: Confirm pre-prod capacity reservation and runbook by 2026-12-10.
- [ ] Dylan: Push DocuSign final and ensure finance has invoiced first month.

I’ll keep a running status note in the HubSpot deal (link in related_links). If anything changes on timeline we’ll flag immediately.

Tessa
